Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages

Record Class StorePageBuilders.QuickStats

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages.StorePageBuilders.QuickStats
Record Components:
available - Available pets.
pending - Pending pets.
sold - Sold pets.
ordersPlaced - Placed orders.
ordersApproved - Approved orders.
ordersDelivered - Delivered orders.
petTotal - All pets, the inventory meter's maximum.
Enclosing class:
StorePageBuilders
public static record StorePageBuilders.QuickStats(long available, long pending, long sold, long ordersPlaced, long ordersApproved, long ordersDelivered, long petTotal) extends Record
The Store page's quick-stat tiles, shared by both render paths.
Example:

var qs = QuickStats.of(store);
